description: This PHP script handles an AJAX request to retrieve and process system status information such as battery level, internet connectivity, Wi-Fi status, MoCA, and firewall settings. It performs session validation, gathers data from various system settings using getStr() calls, determines status classes, and outputs a JSON-encoded configuration for use in a web UI.

methods.name: get_tips
methods.description: Generates tooltip text based on the target system component and its status.
